title: Parts become a mechanism
explanation: Two toothed gears and a central shaft form a mechanical assembly. This is a static illustrative arrangement, not a working gear simulation.

objects.label: Drive gear
objects.description: The input gear. Teeth around the rim make the relationship visible.

objects.label: Driven gear
objects.description: The receiving gear, shown alongside the drive gear.

objects.label: Shaft
objects.description: A cylinder rotated onto the depth axis.
